PDF Interactive Visualization of Unstructured Grids Using Hierarchical 3D ...
Abstract We present a system for interactively rendering large, unstructured grids. Our approach is to voxelize the grid into a 3D voxel octree, and then to render the data using hierarchical, 3D texture mapping.
